messages.subject: Brookmere MSA - first draft for your review
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

First full draft of the MSA attached (v1). I've put the liability cap at 100% of trailing 12-month Fees as our opening position - expect Denham Lewis to push hard on that. SLA is 99.7% with the standard credit table. Can you sense-check the data licence schedule and the DPA against Caspian's standard sub-processor list?

James

--
James Osei
Senior Associate, Commercial
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Brookmere MSA - first draft for your review
messages.plaintextBody:
Looks good. Two things: (1) sub-processor list in Annex 3 matches Caspian's current DPA, fine; (2) I'd flag in the cover note that the dataset disclaimer in clause 9 is the one Brookmere will likely attack given they're using Output for TCFD/ISSB disclosure. Otherwise happy to send.

Elena
